name: post-obstacle-curve-retention-v1
purpose: recover the last seed42-finishing FastCornerCarry baseline and add one bounded steering-retention factor only through a detected obstacle's same-side miss latch into a continuing curve

evidence.seed42_interpretation: The02:26 unbound same-map run immediately after FastCornerCarry finished with zero collisions. The02:46 run after TranslationInvariantExit and the03:20 run after CoherentCurveAttack both collide at the identical37.81-percent obstacle with a later path-space reversal.
